title: GAX-P02 - Phase closeout and final baseline identity freeze
outcome: Close P02 after freezing every required baseline identity/access/license status, restore the original phase boundary, and move real external-model execution into the frozen P08 paper-evaluation track.
rationale: P02 was defined to make comparison mechanics reproducible before GAX v0 training, not to require all expensive external-model inference before GAX exists. Issue #6 and the P02 harness contract require explicit revision/access/license status and qualified adapter paths. Those requirements are now satisfiable without fabricating benchmark numbers. Keeping real external inference as a P02 blocker would create a compute dependency that contradicts the roadmap and the zero-founder-cost constraint.
scope_in: Freeze BioClinical ModernBERT-base as the clinical encoder control with immutable Hugging Face revision and MIT license
Freeze Qwen3.5-4B as the structured-output LLM control with immutable Hugging Face revision and Apache-2.0 license
Verify every required P02 baseline class has explicit identity, revision/access, license, and qualification status
Move real model execution and final benchmark numbers to P08 after benchmark/model/calibration freeze
Close P02 infrastructure phase and advance the canonical frontier to P03 GAX v0

structured-output-llm registry entry freezes Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B at a7b0d22b993d71000cf2eadfb37222a67cee521e with Apache-2.0 license
CLM, Laya, decider, restricted-logit, clinical-encoder, and structured-output-llm all have explicit revision/access/license/qualification records

P02 documentation distinguishes infrastructure qualification from P08 real-model benchmark execution
P02 task ledger closes infrastructure deliverables and moves real-model executions to P08
P03 is unblocked without introducing a benchmark number or clinical claim
Exact-head CI passes Ruff, mypy strict, pytest, and compileall on Python 3.11/3.12 across Linux and Windows

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000005 governance changes and return to canonical SG-000004 closeout at b6b30af27c3d6e9d603c5b4407b7ba1e61ab6d24. No model weights or benchmark predictions are changed.

minimality.rationale: The remaining P02 gap is model identity/provenance for two planned baseline classes plus a contradictory phase boundary. No runtime implementation is required to satisfy the original P02 exit contract.

requirements: Do not convert model identity freeze into a performance claim.
Do not execute final test benchmarks before P08 freeze.
Keep all failed/parsing external inference visible when P08 runs occur.

unresolved_decisions: Task-specific clinical encoder training hyperparameters remain a P08 preregistration item.
Structured-output decoding grammar and generation budget remain a P08 preregistration item.
Jev inclusion remains blocked on reproducible access and terms.
